scope: development-only strength of the existing centered ridge and nearest-centroid leaf baselines; previously used HAM groups and frozen features
support_pool: 112 already logged training groups, 16 per diagnosis
sampling: independent random permutation of the 16 available cases in each diagnosis; take nested prefixes across budgets; paired across both heads and backbones
metrics: mean and empirical 2.5/50/97.5 percentiles of correct-group counts and represented-class macro recall; paired corrected minus lost under ridge; per-diagnosis denominators and mean correct counts
control: check both original balanced E01 predictions; compare the dual ridge to its thin-SVD solution for each support, budget, backbone and evaluation row
interpretation: conditional support composition sensitivity on fixed previously examined development sets; no calibration, target risk claim, confidence intervals or choice of a winning configuration
